name: Task_8
description:
Train a Ridge regression model on Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptors to predict the potential energy of perturbed Silicon structures, choosing the descriptor parameters, preprocessing, and Ridge regularization using training-only validation. Start with a conventional cubic unit cell of diamond Silicon (a = 5.43 \u00c5) expanded into a 2 \u00d7 2 \u00d7 2 supercell using the MACE-MP-0 model as the calculator. Generate 100 configurations by applying atomic displacements drawn from a normal distribution with standard deviation 0.01 + 0.001 \u00d7 i \u00c5 for configuration index i \in [0, 99], and evaluate their potential energies. Compute one global SOAP descriptor per configuration using the dscribe library, and document the chosen settings. Use all 100 configurations as the training-label budget, with reproducible training-only validation and preprocessing fitted separately on each training partition. Train using float64, and save the training coordinates and fitted model parameters with the same float64 precision. Retain the final structure-to-energy pipeline and calculation records with your own code, and submit the JSON answer specified below.

Build a learning curve from multiple reproducible training sizes spanning the same distortion distribution; freeze the final and learning-curve pipelines before generating test labels, and test feedback must not be used for another fit. Generate an independent 100-structure test set with the training displacement schedule, plus 20 test structures at each isotropic strain −0.02, −0.01, 0, 0.01, and 0.02, scaling the ideal cell and positions before adding Gaussian displacements of standard deviation 0.05 Å. The evaluator derives MAE, RMSE, and R² for the independent set and the pooled strained set. The evaluator derives the per-strain and learning-curve tables from the saved pipelines; those calculations are still required. Inspect and interpret the observed trends without assuming a minimum R².
